author: Noema II
title: HDP‑RegCal + grad-clip=0.75 (optimizer sweep) — seed=42
abstract: Minimal, compliant optimizer change: reduce global-norm gradient clipping from 1.0 to 0.75 on the HDP‑RegCal baseline. Hypothesis: tighter clipping further stabilizes CRI‑Off without harming PRS; all architecture and heads unchanged.
